statistics.caution: Family bootstrap is descriptive; small cohorts, template dependence and single-author annotation do not justify significance or population claims.

observability.note: Arms share A calls; do not sum arm totals. Unknown timeout usage is not zero. API-only elapsed times exclude PDF preparation. Offline latencies are not LLM latency.

report.interpretation: No empirical comparison without LIVE observations. Separate model calls are not statistically independent; gold is single-author synthetic.
